ValidationRule.description: Chicago Fan: fan arrangement and wheel type are required from stage 3.0 onward. Built inactive; activated live in step 6.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.SPX_Bypass_Validation_Rules), ISPICKVAL(Brand__c, "Chicago Fan"), OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "3.0 Spec and Influence"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "4.0 Solution and Proposal"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "5.0 Negotiate and Close")), OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Fan_Arrangement__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Wheel_Type__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fan arrangement and wheel type are required before moving to Spec and Influence or later for Chicago Fan.
